rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no cake left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let the setting do some of the work.

card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. 'Sorry about the vase.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Now send it to the people you blamed for it.

card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just said yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And I changed my mind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I suppose it can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.

card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took yours last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You added that box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.

card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me finish the party cleanup log: who packed the speakers, cleared the kitchen, and locked up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is this about your missing cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've also got a missing speaker lead and no lock-up time. Let's fill all three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just write who handled the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add them under kitchen, then stay for speakers and keys. I need the whole handover.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level, and driver's name after nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you need the driver's name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To complete the journey entry. I've got three empty boxes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never kept a log before that dent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can start with yesterday's journeys, if that's fairer. Mileage, fuel, driver for each.

card.title: Make It Official
card.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long is the appointment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

card.title: Make It Official
card.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you be honorary patron of our roof appeal? You'd open it and thank the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can come, but I won't make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then accept the patron's ribbon and lead the applause. That can be your ceremonial duty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The patron applauds every donor. We couldn't have the later ones thinking their money mattered less.

card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because it's raining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This isn't a new policy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A precedent is much smaller.

card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's had an extension before.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.

card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you designed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.

card.title: Choose the Precedent
card.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The handbook says lock the hall at six. Our festival permit says stay open till eight. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the permit governs public access, and the handbook governs everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we canceling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?

card.title: Choose the Precedent
card.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do we seat Grandma first or the birthday child? Both are family traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're both important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's one chair at the head of the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Add another chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Shall I record furniture expansion as the governing tradition?

card.title: Interpret the Custom
card.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I leave for my shift, how much lasagne will you save me? Family custom says 'a proper portion.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't say how big.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll find out what 'proper' means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brothers want seconds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save mine before you serve those. I'd like being expected home to count before being hungry twice.

card.title: Interpret the Custom
card.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?

card.title: Withdraw the Objection
card.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Withdraw the demand for the manager's home number. Your missed-delivery claim can go through our review desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That desk ignored me last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then include last week's reference. The review form has a box for unanswered claims.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you help me fill it in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's put both missed replies under that reference and leave the private-number request out.

card.title: Withdraw the Objection
card.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.
